svg.text: Two-layer roles: the screen for convenience, the backend's guard for security
Concept 5 · the role from GET /auth/me · the backend's guard (onRequest in backend/src/auth/security.ts) checks EVERY route
• control buttons are rendered only when useAdmin() is
true: the admin role is CERTAIN from GET /auth/me
• not "hide when viewer": while the role is still
loading, no button gets a chance to flash
• a viewer doesn't see + New rule and Edit either;
Hiding a button is NOT protection.
A viewer can still send a POST themselves (Bruno, Console):
from a viewer account, with a valid wristband (cookie access)
the guard onRequest: checked in order, BEFORE the route runs
only for methods other than GET/HEAD; Bruno sends no Origin
wristband (cookie access) valid and not expired?
not logged in or session expired:
admin role, or a GET/HEAD method?
all four passed → Zod checks the body (400) → the route runs (200, 409, 504, …)
403 comes BEFORE the body is checked: a viewer who sends a wrong body
Proof in Bruno: layer 2 still works when the screen is bypassed
{"message":"viewer accounts can only look; commands and changes are admin-only"}
with the device's ack: the lamp turns on (if the device is online)
A viewer may still read: GET /devices, GET /rules, GET /auth/me, and Socket.IO (telemetry, status, event).
A role changed through the CLI (npm run users -- role …): the screen uses it after a reload; the backend's guard within 15 minutes (the wristband's lifetime).
